title: Williams and Walker at the Hoofers Club
summary: Green says Bert Williams and George Walker, the fastest feet in the world, frequented the Hoofers Club; Walker died of tuberculosis.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Was Bert Williams a member of the Hoofer's Club?

Yes. They were stars. See, Walker was known as the fastest feet in the world. See? His partner. In fact, he died. Got some kind of spot on his lung, and they wasn't as curable in those days, of the tuberculosis, as they are now. In other words, they didn't have the miraculous drugs, you see.
But Bert Williams would frequent the Hoofer's Club as well.
Oh, yeah. Stars would occasion themselves, you see.
